pages.text: $(bold)Time Cell Moon Palace$(): moonlight condenses into time-cells; within one palace, every thought stands still.$(br2)$(bold)Expansion$(): press the domain expansion key to unfold the domain around yourself - it seals its occupants in like any other domain, draining radius x55 curse power per second. Every target inside except the caster is struck by $(red)the same standstill freeze as a botched Projection Technique$() - unable to move, attack, use items, or turn their view (refreshed every 5 ticks until the domain ends).

$(bold)Exemptions$(): players with the $(bold)Heavenly Restriction - Tyrant$() body (curse-less pure physical powerhouses) are $(red)immune to this domain's freeze$() - moonlight cannot bind a body that carries no curse.$(br2)$(bold)Resisting$(): the universal resistance period applies (a target entering for the first time resists briefly); the three New Shadow Style techniques can resist this domain's freeze (as with Taizang Field - only Execution cannot be resisted). When the domain closes, every freeze inside is lifted at once.
